points: Your site shows over 10,000 happy faces, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so new buyers get no reason to trust the drink. Put the number on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.
The same copy runs in 11 of 29 ads, so repeat viewers tune it out and the pitch goes stale. Keep the body copy, but change the opening line and creative in each of those 11 ads.
11 of 29 copy ads open on the apple juice sold out line, and the rest are single use, so the account leans on one story. Test two new angles against that opener, one on taste and one on the 8g fiber.

11 ads have run 60+ days, so the oldest copy is a proven winner, but it may tire as the same buyers see it again. Build three more variations of that winner, changing the first line and the creative in each.
